Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs multiple proteomics strategies: 1) Phosphopeptide enrichment (Fe-NTA) to identify S37 phosphorylation, 2) TMT-based quantitative proteomics to identify proteins regulated by cGAS knockdown, and 3) SILAC for chromatin-bound protein quantification. scope: Anti-cGAS antibody-mediated immunoprecipitation (IP) was performed with whole cell lysates derived from three 10-cm dishes of HCT116 cells.

The IP proteins were resolved by SDS–PAGE and identified by Coomassie staining. The bands containing cGAS were reduced with 10 mM DTT for 30 min, alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide for 45 min, and in-gel-digested with trypsin enzymes. The resulting peptides were extracted from the gel and analysed by microcapillary reversed-phase (C18) liquid chromatography (LC)–MS/MS
